title: RealtimeWAM: One-Step Asynchronous World Action Models
title_zh: RealtimeWAM：单步异步世界动作模型

paragraphs.en: World Action Models (WAMs) incorporate visual representations from video generation backbones to guide action prediction. Recent efficient WAMs adopt Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architectures and compute video representations once for reuse by the action expert. However, intra-expert iteration ( i.e. , multi-step action denoising) and inter-expert waiting ( i.e. , sequential execution of the video and action experts) still limit inference efficiency. To this end, we present RealtimeWAM, an extremely efficient WAM variant with one-step action generation and asynchronous inference, addressing these two bottlenecks. To reduce intra-expert iteration, we propose Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD) to address a local-global error gap: low local consistency error alone does not guarantee accurate final actions. TACD supplements local consistency with explicit supervision from the frozen teacher’s multi-step rollout endpoint, enabling accurate one-step action generation. Additionally, we propose Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP) to eliminate unnecessary expert-level waiting. It overlaps the two experts through block-wise sharing of the video KV cache, synchronizing only immediately before the corresponding action attention consumes it. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks ( e.g. , LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin) and model variants ( e.g. , Fast-WAM and Faster-WAM) demonstrate the superiority of RealtimeWAM. Notably, RealtimeWAM maintains near-lossless performance ( i.e. , < 1 % <1\% drop) across these benchmarks while delivering significant end-to-end speedup ( e.g. , ∼ 25 × \sim 25\times on H100). paragraphs.zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）整合了视频生成主干网络中的视觉表示，以指导动作预测。 近期高效的 WAMs 采用了 Transformer 混合（MoT）架构，并仅计算一次视频表示供动作专家重复使用。 然而，专家内部迭代（即多步动作去噪）和专家间等待（即视频专家与动作专家的顺序执行）仍然限制了推理效率。 为此，我们提出了 RealtimeWAM——一种极其高效的 WAM 变体，具备单步动作生成和非同步推理能力，从而解决了这两个瓶颈问题。 为减少专家内部迭代，我们提出了教师锚定一致性蒸馏（TACD），以解决局部-全局误差差异问题：仅靠较低的局部一致性误差无法保证最终动作的准确性。 TACD 通过冻结教师的多步推理终点的显式监督来补充局部一致性，从而实现精确的单步动作生成。 此外，我们提出了跨专家波前流水线（CEWP），以消除不必要的专家级等待时间。 该方法通过分块共享视频 KV 缓存使两个专家并行处理，仅在对应动作注意力即将使用缓存时进行同步。 在多个基准数据集（例如 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboTwin）及模型变体（例如 Fast-WAM 和 Faster-WAM）上进行的广泛实验证明了 RealtimeWAM 的优越性。 值得注意的是，RealtimeWAM 在这些基准测试中几乎保持了无损性能（即性能下降 <1%），同时实现了显著的端到端加速（例如在 H100 上加速约 25 倍）。 我们的代码和检查点可通过此链接获取。

paragraphs.en: World Action Models (WAMs) ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Bi et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation by jointly modeling future visual observations and robot actions. Unlike conventional Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models ( Shukor et al., 2025 ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Bjorck et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) that map visual observations and language instructions directly to actions, WAMs incorporate future visual prediction as an additional learning objective. This supervision encourages policies to capture the physical dynamics and temporal structure of robot–environment interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）（Yuan 等，2026；Ye 等，2026；Bi 等，2026；Li 等，2026a；Kim 等，2026；Zhao 等，2026）已成为机器人操控领域一种前景广阔的范式，它通过联合建模未来的视觉观察结果和机器人动作来实现。 与传统的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型（Shukor 等，2025；Intelligence 等，2025；Kim 等，2024；Bjorck 等，2025；Black 等，2024；Liu 等，2025）不同，后者将视觉观察结果和语言指令直接映射为动作，而 WAMs 则将未来视觉预测作为额外的学习目标纳入其中。 这种监督机制促使策略能够捕捉机器人与环境相互作用中的物理动态和时序结构。

paragraphs.en: Based on whether video and action modeling use the same network, WAM architectures can be broadly divided into two categories. Representative shared-backbone WAMs ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) jointly denoise video and action tokens within a single backbone. Consequently, iterative denoising of long token sequences through the heavy video backbone increases inference latency. In contrast, some efficient Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT)-based WAMs ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) offer a promising alternative: the video expert computes representations once , while a separate action expert reuses them for action generation.
paragraphs.zh: 根据视频建模与动作建模是否使用同一网络，WAM 架构可大致分为两类。 典型的共享主干 WAM（Kim et al., 2026；Ye et al., 2026）在单一主干网络内联合去除视频和动作标记的噪声。 因此，通过繁重的视频主干网络对长标记序列进行迭代去噪会增加推理延迟。 相比之下，一些高效的基于混合变换器（MoT）的 WAM（Yuan et al., 2026；Zhao et al., 2026）提供了一种有前景的替代方案：视频专家一次性计算表示，而独立的动作专家则复用这些表示来生成动作。

paragraphs.en: Despite advancements in inference pipeline design, these MoT-based WAMs still incur substantial latency. Specifically, even on advanced GPUs ( e.g. , H100 in Fig. 1 ), these models ( e.g. , Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) ) require over 300 ms for a single inference call. We identify two inference bottlenecks that remain insufficiently addressed in existing MoT-based WAMs: ➀ Intra-expert iteration arises from multi-step action denoising. We observe that the action expert accounts for nearly 90% of end-to-end latency for action generation across diverse GPUs (see Fig. 1 ). ➁ Inter-expert waiting stems from sequential execution of the video and action experts. As shown in Fig. 4 (a), the action expert begins execution only after the video expert completes its forward pass, causing unnecessary waiting.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管推理流程设计取得了进步，但这些基于 MoT 的 WAM 仍然会产生显著的延迟。 具体而言，即使在先进的 GPU（例如图 1 中的 H100）上，这些模型（例如 Fast-WAM（Yuan 等人，2026））单次推理调用也需要超过 300 毫秒。 我们识别出两个在现有基于 MoT 的 WAM 中仍未得到充分解决的关键推理瓶颈：➀ 专家内部迭代源于多步骤动作降噪过程。 我们观察到，在不同 GPU 上，动作专家在动作生成端到端延迟中占比接近 90%（见图 1）。➁ 专家间等待则源于视频专家与动作专家的顺序执行。 如图 4（a）所示，动作专家只有在视频专家完成其前向传播后才会开始执行，这导致了不必要的等待。

paragraphs.en: To combat intra-expert iteration, we propose Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD) for one-step action generation. TACD addresses a local-global error gap in conventional consistency distillation, which only constrains local consistency while neglecting to explicitly penalize the global target action error. TACD adopts the frozen teacher’s multi-step rollout endpoint as a numerical proxy for the exact clean endpoint, explicitly aligning the student’s velocity prediction with the corresponding interval-averaged teacher velocity. From a theoretical perspective, we show that this teacher anchor directly constrains the total endpoint error, complementing local consistency supervision with an explicit action endpoint constraint.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决专家内部迭代问题，我们提出了一种用于单步动作生成的教师锚定一致性蒸馏（TACD）方法。 TACD解决了传统一致性蒸馏中存在的局部-全局误差差异问题：传统方法仅约束局部一致性，却忽略了明确惩罚全局目标动作的误差。 TACD采用冻结教师的多步展开终点作为精确干净终点的数值代理，从而明确地将学生的速度预测与对应的区间平均教师速度对齐。 从理论角度来看，我们证明了这种教师锚点能够直接约束总终点误差，从而在局部一致性监督的基础上增加了对动作终点的显式约束。

paragraphs.en: To reduce inter-expert waiting, we introduce Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP), which transforms coarse expert-wise execution into a fine-grained block-wise pipeline. Under conventional expert-wise execution, the Action Expert waits for the Video Expert to construct the complete block-wise KV cache. We first conduct an in-depth dependency analysis, observing that each action block requires the video KV cache only from its corresponding video block, rather than the complete output of the Video Expert. Motivated by this observation, CEWP overlaps the execution of the two experts through block-wise sharing of the video KV cache, synchronizing only immediately before the corresponding action attention consumes it, which significantly reduces unnecessary waiting.
paragraphs.zh: 为减少专家间的等待时间，我们提出了跨专家波前流水线（CEWP），它将粗粒度的按专家执行方式转化为细粒度的按块流水线。 在传统的按专家执行方式下，动作专家需要等待视频专家构建完整的按块 KV 缓存。 我们首先进行了深入的依赖分析，发现每个动作块仅需使用与其对应的视频块的 KV 缓存，而非视频专家的完整输出。 基于这一观察，CEWP 通过按块共享视频 KV 缓存来重叠两个专家的执行，仅在对应动作注意力即将使用该缓存时进行同步，从而显著减少了不必要的等待。

paragraphs.en: RealtimeWAM achieves impressive results on representative MoT-based WAM architectures, including Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) and Faster-WAM ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , across diverse downstream benchmarks ( e.g. , LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) , and RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025 ) ). On these benchmarks, it delivers approximately 14 ∼ 25 × 14\sim 25\times inference acceleration with an average < 1 % <1\% accuracy drop compared with the original multi-step models. Notably, RealtimeWAM’s per-call inference latency is significantly shorter than the corresponding execution time ( e.g. , 30 Hz control frequency), enabling real-time action generation. These results demonstrate that RealtimeWAM remains effective across diverse robot configurations, task horizons, and distribution conditions, and provide a practical path toward efficient WAM deployment.

paragraphs.en: ▶ \blacktriangleright We propose RealtimeWAM, a one-step asynchronous WAM that addresses both intra-expert iteration and inter-expert waiting in any MoT-based WAM for efficient robot manipulation. ▶ \blacktriangleright We propose Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD), which mitigates the local-global error gap by augmenting local consistency supervision with a teacher endpoint constraint for accurate one-step action generation. ▶ \blacktriangleright We introduce Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP), which reduces unnecessary synchronization by overlapping block-wise execution of the Video and Action Experts according to their data dependencies. ▶ \blacktriangleright Extensive experiments demonstrate that RealtimeWAM achieves real-time action generation with < 1 % <1\% accuracy degradation ( i.e. , 12.2 ms inference latency with ∼ 25 × \sim 25\times speedup on an NVIDIA H100 GPU).
paragraphs.zh: ▶ \blacktriangleright 我们提出了 RealtimeWAM，这是一种单步异步 WAM，能够解决任何基于 MoT 的 WAM 中专家内部迭代和专家间等待的问题，从而实现高效的机器人操控。▶ \blacktriangleright 我们提出了教师锚定一致性蒸馏（TACD），通过用教师端点约束增强局部一致性监督，从而缩小局部与全局之间的误差差距，实现精确的单步动作生成。▶ \blacktriangleright 我们引入了跨专家波前流水线（CEWP），根据视频专家和动作专家的数据依赖关系，通过重叠它们的分块执行，减少了不必要的同步操作。▶ \blacktriangleright 大量实验表明，RealtimeWAM 能够以 <1% 的精度下降（即，在 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上实现约 25 倍加速，推理延迟为 12.2 毫秒）达成实时动作生成。

paragraphs.en: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models ( Shukor et al., 2025 ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Bjorck et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) rely on pretrained vision-language backbones to map visual observations and language instructions directly to actions, World Action Models (WAMs) ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Bi et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) incorporate future visual representations from video generation backbones to guide action prediction. Modern WAMs can be broadly classified into two categories. ➀ One line of work focuses on shared-backbone WAMs, which model future video and robot actions within a shared backbone, including DreamZero ( Ye et al., 2026 ) and Cosmos ( Kim et al., 2026 ) . ➁ In contrast, Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT)-based WAMs, such as Motus ( Bi et al., 2026 ) , employ separate video and action experts that interact through attention. Among these methods, Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) reduces inference overhead by computing video representations once for reuse by the action expert. Subsequent works, including Light-WAM ( Li et al., 2026c ) and Faster-WAM ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , further improve computational efficiency and out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness. Nevertheless, these methods may incur substantial performance degradation on challenging benchmarks or achieve limited speedups.

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2020 ) and flow models ( Lipman et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2022 ; Albergo et al., 2023 ) have become cornerstones of modern high-quality image and video generation. However, their iterative sampling cost has motivated a series of few-step acceleration methods, including progressive distillation ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ) , consistency models ( Song et al., 2023 ) , distribution matching distillation ( Yin et al., 2024 ) , MeanFlow ( Geng et al., 2025 ) , and adversarial distillation ( Sauer et al., 2024 ) . These distillation techniques have recently been introduced into World Action Models ( Akbari et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . The work most relevant to ours is Flash-WAM ( Akbari et al., 2026 ) , which identifies a modality-dependent noise-regime mismatch and introduces modality-specific consistency parameterizations. However, ➀ it focuses on few-step distillation for WAMs that retain future-video denoising during inference, such as LingBot-VA ( Li et al., 2026a ) ; and ➁ its ultra-few-step ( i.e. , one-step) distillation still exhibits noticeable performance degradation ( e.g. , RoboTwin and real-world tasks). These limitations motivate our investigation of one-step action distillation for MoT-based WAMs.

paragraphs.en: Asynchronous inference has been widely studied for real-time robot control because it mitigates execution stalls, stale observations, and delayed responses caused by policy latency. Existing approaches can be broadly grouped into three categories: execution-level asynchrony, module-level asynchrony, and sampling-level asynchrony. Execution-level methods overlap prediction of the next action chunk with execution of the current one and maintain continuity through prefix conditioning, state correction, or chunk fusion ( Black et al., 2025a ; Black et al., 2025b ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Motubrain Team, 2026 ) . Module-level methods decouple a slow semantic or world module from a fast action module, allowing cached high-level representations to guide high-frequency action updates ( Hirose et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ) . Sampling-level methods assign different action positions, chunks, modalities, or denoising streams distinct sampling schedules, enabling early action output or selective refinement without waiting for full decoding ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . In contrast, RealtimeWAM employs finer-grained asynchrony at the block level, distinguishing it from prior approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 异步推理已被广泛用于实时机器人控制，因为它能够缓解策略延迟所导致的执行停滞、观测信息过时以及响应延迟等问题。 现有方法大致可分为三类：执行层异步、模块层异步和采样层异步。 执行层方法将下一个动作分块的预测与当前动作的执行重叠进行，并通过前缀条件约束、状态修正或分块融合来保持连续性（Black et al., 2025a ; Black et al., 2025b ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Motubrain Team, 2026）。 模块层方法将较慢的语义或世界模型模块与较快的动作模块解耦，使缓存的高层表示能够指导高频的动作更新（Hirose et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026）。 采样层方法为不同的动作位置、分块、模态或去噪流分配独立的采样时间表，从而实现提前输出动作或选择性优化，而无需等待完整解码（Jiang et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b）。 相比之下，RealtimeWAM 在块层级采用了更精细的异步机制，这与先前的方法有所不同。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose RealtimeWAM , a one-step asynchronous world action model for post-training acceleration of any MoT-based WAM. paragraphs.en: As discussed above, multi-step action denoising dominates inference latency (Fig. 1 ) while video latent representations are computed in a single forward pass in the Video Expert. Therefore, our target is to achieve high-quality few-step action generation (especially one-step) to combat intra-expert iteration. Recent step distillation strategies ( Song et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2024 ; Geng et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) have been extensively studied in image and video generation. However, we identify a distinctive characteristic of action generation in WAMs: denoising is strongly conditioned on visual observations, robot states, and language instructions, which can confine feasible actions ( e.g. , grasp positions and gripper commands) to a narrow range. Within this constrained action space, even subtle deviations can affect task success rates owing to the high sensitivity of robotic control to action errors.
paragraphs.zh: 如上文所述，多步动作去噪在推理延迟中占主导地位（图 1），而视频潜在表示则在视频专家模型中通过单次前向传播计算得出。 因此，我们的目标是实现高质量的小步数动作生成（尤其是一步生成），以应对专家模型内部的迭代问题。 近期的步骤蒸馏策略（Song 等人，2023；Yin 等人，2024；Geng 等人，2025；Huang 等人，2026）已在图像和视频生成领域得到了广泛研究。 然而，我们识别出 WAMs 中动作生成的一个独特特性：去噪过程强烈依赖于视觉观察结果、机器人状态和语言指令，这可能会将可行的动作（例如抓取位置和夹爪命令）限制在一个狭窄的范围内。 在这一受限的动作空间中，即使是微小的偏差也可能影响任务成功率，因为机器人控制对动作错误具有高度敏感性。

paragraphs.en: However, directly applying consistency distillation to WAMs raises a significant challenge, dubbed the local-global error gap . In Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD), we obtain the teacher endpoint through a 10-step rollout of the frozen teacher and set the teacher-anchored loss weight to λ = 0.2 \lambda=0.2 . Training proceeds for 30,000 iterations with AdamW, a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and a weight decay of 10 − 2 10^{-2} . We set the exponential moving average (EMA) decay to 0.995 0.995 . For a fair comparison, all evaluated step-distillation methods, including distribution matching distillation (DMD) ( Yin et al., 2024 ) , consistency distillation ( Song et al., 2023 ) , and MeanFlow distillation ( Geng et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2026 ) , adopt the same training settings. Moreover, we compare against other efficient WAMs, including Flash-WAM ( Akbari et al., 2026 ) and Light-WAM ( Li et al., 2026c ) . For latency evaluation, we include VAE encoding time but exclude text encoding time, as instructions are encoded only once per episode.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate RealtimeWAM on LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , and LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) , using task success rate as the evaluation metric. paragraphs.en: Effect of different components. We first validate the effectiveness of the key components of our distillation framework (Tab. 4 ). Fine-tuning the Video Expert during action step distillation reduces the overall success rate while introducing additional training overhead ( i.e. , longer training time and higher peak memory usage, as reported in Appendix A ). With the Video Expert frozen, augmenting ℒ CD \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CD}} with ℒ TA \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{TA}} , yielding Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD), further improves the reported overall success rate from 89.85% to 90.84%. This improvement is consistent with our analysis: the teacher anchor provides an endpoint reference from the complete teacher trajectory, supplementing local consistency supervision with an explicit endpoint constraint to mitigate global deviations that the local objective may leave unresolved.

paragraphs.en: Efficiency Results. RealtimeWAM reduces inference latency through algorithm and system co-optimization (Fig. 5 ). In addition to TACD and CEWP, we employ CUDA Graph and efficient kernels from LightX2V ( LightX2V Contributors, 2025 ) (see Appendix F.2 ). On Fast-WAM and Faster-WAM, TACD reduces latency from 299.7 and 218.9 ms to 65.8 and 57.1 ms, yielding 4.56 × 4.56\times and 3.83 × 3.83\times speedups, respectively. After enabling CUDA Graph, CEWP further reduces latency from 23.3 to 17.4 ms on Fast-WAM and from 26.2 to 22.4 ms on Faster-WAM, providing additional speedups of 1.34 × 1.34\times and 1.17 × 1.17\times . With all optimizations enabled, RealtimeWAM achieves inference latencies of 12.2 and 16.1 ms, corresponding to overall speedups of 24.55 × 24.55\times and 13.56 × 13.56\times over the respective baselines. Detailed latency results on other GPUs ( e.g. , RTX 4090D and RTX 5090) are provided in Appendix F.5 (Tab. F.3 ).

paragraphs.en: We presented RealtimeWAM, a post-training framework that accelerates MoT-based WAMs by addressing intra-expert iteration and inter-expert waiting. Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation complements local consistency supervision with a teacher endpoint constraint, enabling accurate one-step action generation. Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining overlaps block-wise execution of the Video and Action Experts through fine-grained synchronization, reducing unnecessary waiting. RealtimeWAM enables real-time action generation ( e.g. , 12.2 ms latency) with near-lossless policy performance on MoT-based WAMs, including Fast-WAM and Faster-WAM, while delivering significant end-to-end speedups across diverse hardwares ( e.g. , approximately 14 ∼ 25 × 14\sim 25\times on H100).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 RealtimeWAM，这是一个后训练框架，通过解决专家内部迭代和专家间等待问题，加速了基于 MoT 的 WAM。 教师锚定一致性蒸馏通过教师端点约束补充了局部一致性监督，从而实现精确的单步动作生成。 跨专家波前流水线通过精细同步重叠视频专家与动作专家的块级执行，减少了不必要的等待。 RealtimeWAM 能够在基于 MoT 的 WAM（包括 Fast-WAM 和 Faster-WAM）上实现实时动作生成（例如，延迟为 12.2 毫秒），同时保持策略性能近乎无损，并在多种硬件上实现了显著的端到端加速（例如，在 H100 上加速约 14 ∼ 25 倍）。

paragraphs.en: 1) Applicability. RealtimeWAM targets MoT-based WAMs and is not directly applicable to shared-backbone architectures such as DreamZero ( Ye et al., 2026 ) . Step distillation in shared-backbone WAMs more closely resembles step distillation in video generation, making action-specific characteristics harder to isolate and motivating our focus on MoT architectures. Within this scope, our framework supports both models that omit explicit future-video prediction at inference ( e.g. , Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) ) and those that retain it ( e.g. , Faster-WAM ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) ).
paragraphs.zh: 1) 适用性。 RealtimeWAM 针对基于 MoT 的 WAM，不适用于 DreamZero（Ye 等人，2026）等共享主干架构。 共享主干 WAM 中的步骤蒸馏更类似于视频生成中的步骤蒸馏，这使得特定于动作的特征更难分离，也促使我们将重点放在 MoT 架构上。 在此范围内，我们的框架既支持在推理时省略明确未来视频预测的模型（例如 Fast-WAM（Yuan 等人，2026）），也支持保留该预测的模型（例如 Faster-WAM（Zhao 等人，2026））。

paragraphs.en: We apply five operator-level optimizations to reduce kernel launches and intermediate memory traffic. (1) We fuse modulation and residual gating into separate element-wise kernels, preserving BF16 intermediate rounding while keeping LayerNorm independent. (2) We fuse each Q/K RMSNorm into a single Triton kernel, retaining FP32 statistics and BF16 intermediate rounding. (3) We fuse RoPE type conversions and complex rotation into a single Triton kernel while retaining FP64 arithmetic. (4) We replace static all-True attention masks with None , preserving masks that exclude attention positions. (5) We pack self-attention Q/K/V and cross-attention K/V projections into single GEMMs, leaving cross-attention Q separate. These optimizations complement CUDA Graph, which reduces CPU submission overhead but does not automatically fuse operators within the graph.
paragraphs.zh: 我们应用了五种操作符级别的优化，以减少内核启动和中间内存流量。 (1) 我们将调制和残差门控融合为独立的逐元素内核，在保持 LayerNorm 独立性的同时，保留了 BF16 中间结果的舍入处理。 (2) 我们将每个 Q/K RMSNorm 融合为一个单一的 Triton 内核，同时保留了 FP32 统计信息和 BF16 中间结果的舍入处理。 (3) 我们将 RoPE 类型转换和复数旋转融合为一个单一的 Triton 内核，同时保留了 FP64 算术运算。 (4) 我们用 None 替换了静态的全真注意力掩码，同时保留了排除注意力位置的掩码。 (5) 我们将自注意力 Q/K/V 和交叉注意力 K/V 投影打包为单一的 GEMM 操作，而将交叉注意力的 Q 单独保留。 这些优化与 CUDA Graph 相辅相成：CUDA Graph 能够减少 CPU 提交开销，但不会自动融合图内的操作符。

sents.en: (3) We fuse RoPE type conversions and complex rotation into a single Triton kernel while retaining FP64 arithmetic.
sents.zh: (3) 我们将 RoPE 类型转换和复数旋转融合为一个单一的 Triton 内核，同时保留了 FP64 算术运算。

paragraphs.en: We qualitatively evaluate RealtimeWAM * on a real-world T-shirt-folding task using a bimanual setup comprising two PiPER robotic arms from AgileX Robotics 3 3 3 https://global.agilex.ai/products/piper , with policy inference running on an NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU. As shown in Figure F.1 , the task involves successive grasping and folding operations that transform an unfolded garment into a compact configuration. It requires temporally coordinated decisions because each fold changes the garment geometry and the grasp locations available for subsequent actions. Early misalignment can therefore affect later folds, making this task a useful setting for examining long-horizon manipulation of deformable objects.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一个由 AgileX Robotics 3 3 3 https://global.agilex.ai/products/piper 提供的两条 PiPER 机械臂组成的双手操作装置，在真实世界的 T 恤折叠任务上对 RealtimeWAM * 进行了定性评估，策略推理在 NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU 上运行。 如图 F.1 所示，该任务包含连续的抓取和折叠操作，将未折叠的衣物转变为紧凑的结构。 由于每次折叠都会改变衣物的几何形状以及后续动作可用的抓取位置，因此需要时间上协调的决策。 因此，早期的偏差可能会影响后续的折叠，这使得该任务成为研究可变形物体长期操控的有效场景。

paragraphs.en: To meet the real-time requirement of this sequential setting, we deploy the RealtimeWAM * model distilled from Fast-WAM, using TACD for one-step action generation and CEWP for block-wise overlap between the Video and Action Experts. In the physical evaluation, consecutive actions proceeded without perceptible pauses, enabling smooth real-time execution even without execution-level asynchrony between policy inference and robot execution, such as Real-Time Chunking (RTC) ( Black et al., 2025a ) . The resulting low-latency inference allows the policy to maintain continuous control throughout the long-horizon folding sequence. In the context of RealtimeWAM * , this task motivates preserving action quality under one-step action generation while reducing inference overhead during sequential execution.
paragraphs.zh: 为满足该序列设置中的实时性要求，我们部署了从 Fast-WAM 蒸馏而来的 RealtimeWAM * 模型，其中使用 TACD 进行单步动作生成，并使用 CEWP 实现视频专家与动作专家之间的块级重叠。 在物理评估中，连续的动作得以无缝执行，没有出现可察觉的停顿，从而实现了流畅的实时运行，即便策略推理与机器人执行之间不存在执行层级的异步机制（例如实时分块（RTC）（Black 等人，2025a））。 由此实现的低延迟推理使策略能够在整个长时域折叠序列中保持连续控制。 在 RealtimeWAM * 的框架下，这项任务要求在单步动作生成的同时保持动作质量，并减少序列执行过程中的推理开销。
